title: Untangling which school he attended in Los Angeles
summary: They try to establish whether he went to night school in Los Angeles while at Bullock's; Mrs. Howard suggests L.A. High.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: In this article it says that you went to school after you got to Los Angeles. Is that right?
After I left Los Angeles?
After you came to Los Angeles, -- said that while you're working Bullock's Willard's (phonetic), you were also going to school.
Oh, yes.. I was going to school.
What school were you going to here? Steubenville
Sumersville (phonetic) High School.
When you got to Los Angeles?
When you were working at Bullock's?
That's what I'm talkin' about. Steubenville High School. That's the one I was going to, all the time.
Yeah, but when you came to Los Angeles, it had to be another. So you were at Steubenville High School before you came out here? So when you came to Los Angeles, right?
Yeah.
Then you still were going to school. Night school or something, in Los Angeles? Do you remember that? You still were studying?
Yeah, still going to night school.
Yeah, but that wasn't Steubenville. It must have been a Los Angeles High School. That was
Oh, yes, it was, too.
Oh, you were here in Los Angeles, then. So, what was it? Los Angeles High School, or one of those schools? (Unintelligible) High School?
Now I'm just like my wife said, I'm gettin' mixed up.
Yeah, but that's all right. But in L.A., wasn't it maybe Jefferson or one of those night--?
No, no, I never went to Jefferson.
Los Angeles High School? Was it--
No.
It was L.A. High, if I'm not mistaken. I don't know, but I've heard him talk about it.

Since it was Los Angeles, you know, it says that you were studying, so we figured you were going to a Los Angeles school then. You were working at Bullock's in the daytime. Did you get a job on the weekends, and then going to school, maybe two or three nights a week, is it possible?
Yeah, but I wadn't playin'-- I was playin' horn, but it was a different way. And I can't get--no use in me tryin'--I can't put that in there because I didn't have no horn. Uh-uh.
But you were playing a little bit on weekends, right?
Yep, I was playin'.
What were--
You know, I was playin', but I'm think of--and it's another name. And his name--what was that guy's
name? Oh, maybe need Susie to help me. I don't know; I can't think of it. I can't think of that name to save my life.
